scope: Read only saved 11 completed trades per arm and four still-open buy-and-hold paths; no strategy/engine/lock entrypoint imports or execution. All saved execution prices (already 100bps slippage) and quantities remain fixed.
rounding: Conservative whole TWD ceiling on commission and tax separately per saved fill, minimum on commission only; a sensitivity assumption, not a verified broker settlement convention. Min1/min20 bracket remains hypothetical unless linked public broker terms are verified. No discounted rates.
corporateActions: Do not invent missing actions or silently claim total return. Official historical dividend records may be documented separately; apply no dividend adjustment to cost sensitivity.
exposure: Descriptive saved capital-time exposure and gross model PnL decomposition only, no resizing or matched-alpha claim.
decisionRule: Report every scenario; retained positive paired difference does not establish profit/alpha or full economic cost coverage. No promotion or retuning.
